case_context: The case is a training investigation where a sensitive recipe was reported on the dark web.
The client interview says the files of concern were stored on the Domain Controller file server.
The published case states the victim network is in the 10.42.x.x space and the incident should be interpreted with Colorado September local time in mind.

Domain Controller disk image for partition metadata and host artifact inventory.
Acquisition-time startup surface that rapidly exposes persistence candidates.
Exported protected hives, user hives, and NTDS material; this workflow uses SOFTWARE and SYSTEM registry hives plus NTUSER UserAssist execution context.
